description: Source code implementing POSIX clock functions for Zephyr OS, including clock_gettime, clock_settime, clock_nanosleep, and gettimeofday, with support for CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

methods.name: z_impl___posix_clock_get_base
methods.description: Retrieves the base time for the specified clock, supporting CLOCK_MONOTONIC and CLOCK_REALTIME.

methods.name: z_vrfy___posix_clock_get_base
methods.description: Verification wrapper for __posix_clock_get_base, used in userspace.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Gets the current time for the specified clock, combining uptime ticks with base time.

methods.name: clock_settime
methods.description: Sets the base time for CLOCK_REALTIME.

methods.name: clock_nanosleep
methods.description: Suspends execution for a specified duration or until an absolute time.

methods.name: clock_getcpuclockid
methods.description: Gets the CPU clock ID for a process, only allows current process.

methods.name: reset_clock_base
methods.description: Resets the clock base to zero, used in testing.

methods.name: clock_base_reset_rule_after
methods.description: Test rule to reset clock base after a test.
